results.instruction: Stop the car on a firm level surface, set up a warning triangle, turn on hazard lights, apply the parking brake, switch off the ignition, and ensure passengers exit.
Retrieve the spare wheel and tools from the trunk, and use the provided tool to remove the hubcap if present.
Use the wrench to loosen the wheel nuts one half to one turn before jacking up the vehicle.
Locate the correct jacking point under the vehicle and position the jack securely.
Jack up the vehicle until the flat tire easily clears the ground.
Remove the wheel nuts completely and take off the flat tire.
Lift the spare wheel onto the hub, align the holes, and replace the wheel nuts, tightening them until firm.
Lower the jack until the spare wheel touches the ground, then tighten the wheel nuts firmly in sequence.
Lower the car completely, remove the jack and tools, and store the flat tire.
Check the wheel nuts after a short distance and remember not to exceed 80 km/h when driving with a compact spare wheel.
